expression_brief: alpha_01: Han-Zhou-Zhu trend signal — z-score of mean(close_adj / MA_k) over k in {3,5,10,20,50,100,200}
alpha_02: 60d log-price linear regression t-stat (slope-t > 0 = persistent up-trend)
alpha_03: 120d log-price linear regression t-stat (longer horizon)
alpha_04: MA-crossover stack: sign(MA20-MA60) + sign(MA60-MA120) + sign(MA120-MA252), integer ∈ [-3,+3]
alpha_05: 252-day rolling close max proximity: close / rolling_max(close_adj, 252)
alpha_06: 60d positive-day fraction × sign(60d cum log-return)  (frog-in-the-pan flavored)
alpha_08: classic 12-1 momentum = sum(daily_log_ret) over t-252 to t-21  [FALSIFICATION ANCHOR]

expected_turnover_direction.alpha_02: medium (slope estimate moves with new bars)
expected_turnover_direction.alpha_05: low (proximity to running max is sticky)
